# [TASK] Integrate Local Cloudflare Tunnel option into Admin DeployControl UI

## Task
Update `DeployControl.jsx` to include a 'Local Workstation / Minikube (Cloudflare Tunnel)' target option with 1-click status checking, tunnel connection info, and documentation.

## Scope
Includes UI updates to `DeployControl.jsx`, a custom tunnel URL override field, and unit tests in `DeployControl.test.jsx`. Superseded: ADR-015 deleted `DeployControl.jsx` entirely, closing the web-triggered deploy surface it was part of. This task's current form is `apiUrl.js`'s tunnel-URL fallback tier.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A local or Minikube backend exposed via `start-tunnel.sh` is reachable from the deployed frontend without a rebuild (`resolveApiUrl()`'s tunnel-fallback tier in `apiUrl.js`, proven by `apiUrl.test.js`'s "falls back to the published tunnel URL when both cloud health checks fail and the tunnel is healthy")
- [x] A manual override of the backend URL remains possible from the browser, replacing the deleted UI's custom-URL field (`getStaticOverride()` in `apiUrl.js`, reading `localStorage.lmdb_api_url`, proven by `apiUrl.test.js`'s "getApiUrl and resolveApiUrl both return the manual localStorage override when set")
- [x] Instructions for the local tunnel live in documentation rather than an Admin UI, since `DeployControl.jsx` was deleted under ADR-015 (`README.md`'s "Local Stack + Tunnel" row, `docs/guides/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md`'s tunneling section)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Delivered in commit `5615fc0`, then superseded by ADR-015 (commit `469e304`), which deleted `DeployControl.jsx` and the rest of its surface because an unauthenticated `/admin` route could trigger real cloud spend. The criteria above describe what replaced it, not the original UI. See #138, #150.
